description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Language' within the Opencart admin module, responsible for generating and clearing language JSON files for localisation purposes.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class managing language file generation and clearing functions in OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates language JSON files for each active language by creating directories and writing JSON data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes existing language JSON files for each language to reset localisation data.
